reasoning: On the season so far the Rockets are the stronger team; with home court the Rockets start about 3 points better, in a game of about 223 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Rockets.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Rockets win 66 times in 100, by about 4; most games like this end between 196 and 244 total points.

analyst.text: Golden State have won eight straight after an 0-3 start, and Steve Kerr says the group is "having fun". That is despite Kristaps Porzingis stepping away for his health while the team withholds his salary and tries to trade him. This game opens a five-game road trip. Houston are thin up front, with Steven Adams and Clint Capela out, and Kevin Durant faces his former team while chasing Kobe Bryant on the all-time scoring list. The Warriors' chemistry is the strongest mental signal, so the lean is slightly toward Golden State.
